title: Shonen Jump’s Newest and Hottest Leading Manga Reaches a Major Milestone
content: Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine has evolved a lot over the last few years, and not necessarily in a good way. In recent years, more manga have ended or been cancelled than have debuted. The magazine has especially struggled to find new leading series besides One Piece .
author: ComicBook

title: New One-Punch Man Season 3 Trailer Hypes 2027 Return – Watch Now
content: One-Punch Man is gearing up to make its return for Season 3 next year, and the first trailer for the next half of the season is showing off the first look at what’s coming next. One-Punch Man has unfortunately been one of the most divisive anime series of the last few years.
author: ComicBook

title: 22 Years Later, Fullmetal Alchemist Fans Are Still Debating the Anime’s Original Ending
content: When it comes to anime series, not many of them can compare to the 2009 hit Shonen Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood . It’s one of the most ambitious projects by Studio Bones, and there’s no denying that the anime made its mark in history.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll Is About to Release a Ton of New Anime for the Biggest Webtoon Hits
content: Crunchyroll is teaming up with HAYATE and LINE Digital to release a ton of new anime based on the biggest Webtoon hits, and fans have gotten the first look at some of the first coming our way in the near future.
author: ComicBook

title: Futurama Returns With Surprise Post-Credits Scene After Season 14 Finale – Watch
content: Futurama has officially ended another season of its revival run with Hulu, but it’s made a surprise return with a new post-credits scene revealing what happened after the final episode. Futurama had four successful seasons of its revival series with Hulu, but the animated series thankfully is far from over.

content: One of the year’s biggest anime movies has been a revival of a classic franchise that had been dormant for over a decade, and now it’s finally set a release date for its launch in theaters across the United States.

title: New Avatar: The Last Airbender Prequel Series to Focus on Fan-Favorite Avatar’s Past
content: Avatar: The Last Airbender has expanded once more with the announcement of a brand new prequel series now in the works for Paramount+, and Avatar Studios promises it will be exploring the past of one of the timeline’s most mysterious Avatars.
